label: the plain and familiar imperatives (bol, bolo, boliye as a series)
note: Chapter 93 teaches the series the point asks for. bolo (-o, the tum level) and boliye (-iye, the aap level) are each introduced by their own lesson, and the bare-stem tu form is taught in the same chapter for RECOGNITION rather than production, because using it wrongly costs far more than using it gains. The -iye lesson also takes maaf kijiye apart, which the note named as the only place the form had appeared: it was a respectful command all along.
